defects.description: The term 'safe value' is mistranslated as 'безопасного замечания' (safe remark/note). In this technical context, 'value' should be 'значение'.
The term 'applied defaults' is mistranslated as 'применённые замечания по умолчанию' (applied remarks by default). 'Defaults' here refers to default values, which should be 'значения по умолчанию'.
